match.reason: The bank point covers the depth of human development as measured by indicators (income, health, education), not the VCE idea of conditions that let people reach their potential, lead productive lives and have choices, and the business point is about workplace staff development, so neither matches.

draft.title: Human development
card: Human development is about expanding people's freedom to live the lives they value. It means creating conditions where people can reach their potential.
Those conditions let people lead productive and creative lives, in line with their needs and interests.
Choice is central. People need real options, such as access to education, health care and a fair say in decisions that affect them.
Human development looks at what people are able to do and be. Economic growth can help, but it is a means and not the goal.
draft.remember: Human development is about people's potential and choices, not only about money.

a.q: Which description best fits human development?
opts: Creating conditions for people to have choices and potential
Increasing the amount of money a country earns each year
Giving every person the same job and the same income
Providing health services only to people who are unwell
a.why: Human development is about people's potential, productive lives and choices. Rising national income can help, but it is not the aim itself.
a.clue: Think about what people can do and be.

b.q: A town in regional Victoria has strong business profits, but many young people have no way to reach a school or training course. What does this show about human development?
opts: It is limited, as young people's choices are restricted
It is high, as the town's business profits are strong
It is unaffected, as business profits decide everything
It is high, as the town has plenty of working adults
b.why: Young people who cannot reach education have fewer choices and less chance to reach their potential. Strong profits do not on their own create those conditions, so the tempting answer about profits is wrong.
b.clue: Ask whether people in the town have real options.

a.best: Creating conditions for people to have choices and potential

b.best: It is limited, as young people's choices are restricted
